## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...).
- [ ] New or changed endpoints are checked against the Microsoft Learn documentation and name their minimum API version.
- [ ] Tests cover the method, path, request body and response decoding.
- [ ] README.md (endpoint coverage) and AGENTS.md are updated if they are affected.
- [ ] Test data contains no real tenant IDs, environment names, email addresses or secrets.
